Que fait une femme de chambre ou un vale: What does a room attendant or valet do day to day?
Le valet ou la femme de chambre prépare: The valet or room attendant prepares rooms before guests arrive and restores them after they leave: beds, bathroom, dusting, welcome amenities, minibar. It is physical, closely supervised work in which consistency matters as much as speed: a room must be flawless at any hour and identical to the one next door. You work as part of a team, under the housekeeper, and you are often the first to spot faulty equipment or a forgotten item.
Vous apprenez en pratiquant : les atelie: You learn by doing: guest-room workshops take place in every session, and each skill is shown, repeated and then corrected by a trainer from the industry. The programme covers organising the trolley and the order of work, the standards of 3- to 5-star hotels, cleaning every surface, making beds and folding linen, turndown service and hygiene and safety rules. You also learn to communicate with the housekeeper and the front desk, because a room is prepared in coordination with the whole team.

Non. La formation est de niveau débutant: No. The course is beginner level: it starts from the basic skills (organising the trolley, cleaning, a perfectly squared bed) and repeats them in workshops until they become second nature. Hotels above all look for rigour, punctuality and discretion.
Quelle est la différence entre une femme: What is the difference between a room attendant and a housekeeper?
La femme de chambre (ou le valet) prépar: The room attendant (or valet) prepares the rooms. The housekeeper organises the work of the whole team, checks every room before guests arrive and manages linen and supplies. It is the natural next step after a few years of experience.
Le métier de femme de chambre est-il phy: Is being a room attendant physically demanding?
Oui, c’est un métier actif : on reste de: Yes, it is an active job: you stand, move around and carry linen and equipment. The course teaches the right movements and posture to limit fatigue, and good physical condition is one of the qualities hotels look for.
Que fait une gouvernante d’hôtel au quot: What does a hotel housekeeper do day to day?
La gouvernante est le chef d’orchestre d: The housekeeper is the conductor of the hotel floors. Each morning, she allocates the rooms between the valets and room attendants according to arrivals and departures, then checks the finished rooms before releasing them to the front desk. She also manages linen, cleaning products and lost property, reports faults to maintenance and prepares VIP guests’ rooms first. The role combines high quality standards, organisation and team management.
La formation s’adresse à des personnes q: The course is designed for people who already know floor work and want to lead it. It covers floor organisation (room allocation, priorities, VIP guests), quality control with checklists and room audits, linen and stock management, team management (briefing, motivating, correcting, training), schedules and indicators, and coordination with the front desk, maintenance and management. Practical workshops are led by accommodation professionals.

Quelle est la différence entre une gouve: What is the difference between a floor housekeeper and an executive housekeeper?
La gouvernante d’étage encadre une équip: The floor housekeeper leads a team on one or several floors. The executive housekeeper runs the whole housekeeping department: schedules, budgets, linen, relations with the front desk and management. It is a natural step in a career path.

Le réceptionniste est le premier visage: The receptionist is the hotel’s first face: welcoming guests, checking them in and out, managing bookings and answering their requests. The night auditor takes over when the hotel goes to sleep: welcoming late arrivals, keeping the premises safe, checking the day’s payments and carrying out the accounting close (“night audit”) in the hotel software before the date changes. It is a job of rigour and composure that requires a great deal of independence.
Le programme couvre le front office (arr: The programme covers the front office (arrivals, departures and getting to grips with hotel software), cash and billing, the close procedure step by step, reports and indicators (occupancy rate, average rate, RevPAR), night-time security and English at the front desk. It also prepares you for situations that come up in the job: a guest arriving without a booking, a billing error, a guest’s special request.
C’est la clôture comptable de la journée: It is the accounting close of the hotel’s day, carried out at night by the auditor in the hotel software: checking invoices and payments, checking occupied rooms, producing reports, then moving on to the next day’s date.
